version.changelog: Initial release. Everything shopify-audit-pro does, plus guarded writes via a single mutate command: preview by default, --confirm to send, a second exact confirmation for high-risk mutations, no retry after ambiguous write failures, userErrors treated as failures, PII-free audit log. Reads, guards and mutation shapes are tested; a live write has not yet been run on a real store.

llm.summary: This is a high-power Shopify admin skill, but its credential, network, file, and write behaviors are disclosed, scoped to the user's Shopify store, and guarded by previews and confirmations.

dimensions.detail: Environment and file access are proportionate to the purpose: Shopify credentials from environment or an optional mode-600 env file, Shopify/store network calls, storage.googleapis.com bulk-result downloads, user-supplied query/output files, and a local audit log.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact requires only python3 and uses a bundled standard-library helper; it does not install packages, run setup scripts, create services, or modify agent settings.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions require read-before-write, preview, explicit confirmation for each write, exact second confirmation for high-risk mutations, post-write verification, PII redaction, and treating store content as untrusted data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill persists an audit log and may read a user-created secrets file, both disclosed; I found no cron jobs, startup hooks, background agents, memory edits, privilege escalation, or hidden persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Shopify administration, including potentially sensitive writes such as refunds, order changes, product edits, discounts, customers, policies, and themes; that high-impact capability is disclosed and central to the skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving an agent Shopify Admin API access. Start with read-only scopes, add write scopes only for the task at hand, use a separate app for higher-risk work, keep secrets out of chat, review every preview carefully, and require the exact high-risk confirmation for refunds, cancellations, deletes, payments, policies, and theme changes.
llm.findings:
[TT3] expected: The reported environment-to-network flow is the expected Shopify token exchange and Admin API call path. The helper validates the store domain as *.myshopify.com and uses the token for Shopify requests, not an unrelated relay.
[SSRF3] expected: The request host is dynamic because it is the user's Shopify store, but the code enforces a strict myshopify.com regex and bulk downloads are limited to https://storage.googleapis.com.
[LP3] unexpected: The lack of declarative allowed-tool metadata is a hardening gap for a high-impact admin skill, but the artifacts themselves disclose and code-enforce narrow network destinations, confirmation gates, and file handling, so this does not justify a Review verdict by itself.
[RA2] expected: The cited evidence is setup text, audit logging, and guarded mutation parsing. I found no unauthorized session persistence, scheduled tasks, startup scripts, or cross-session agent control.
[PE2] expected: The cited chmod 600 text is ordinary secret-file permission guidance, not sudo or root execution.
